features: Free online accessibility checker for Shopify stores. It uses open-source axe-core to test one page per scan and report selected WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A/AA issues. The tool shows a score and flags issues with their impact and frequency. Automated checks cover only part of WCAG; manual testing is still needed. Not a legal certification.
provider: ClearA11y (operated by Mapacina Project S.A. de C.V.)
title: ClearA11y Free Shopify Accessibility Scan
